title: Genuine question, how to openly phrase "Built with AI tools, or it wouldnt have been built at all." Sort of disclaimer.
author: Chacudno
selftext:
I want to find a way to say what I believe which is "this game would not have been made without the use of AI tools, it's the only way I was ever going to get it done."

But I want to say it in better words. Words that are clear and direct but professional.

replies.author: Chacudno
replies.body: Trying to get ahead of every "free thinker" asking if something was made with AI.

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body:
do you need to get ahead of the other kinds of free thinker?  any prepping for woke warriors or antivaxxers?

just ignore the idiots

replies.author: cornelln
replies.body: You don’t need to do that. I think it’s fine to discuss your development process if that interests you. But why walk into an argument for which many points are about subjective value systems of a new tool. You don’t need to take on defending AI.

comments.author: TemporalBias
comments.body:
The more you try to justify it, the less useful that justification becomes when the people you are trying to convince do not care about your justification. They only care that you used AI or not.

In other words, I myself will be saying something along these lines when I release my own AI-developed game: "I worked with AI to make this. If you don't like that, don't play the game."

replies.author: Chacudno
replies.body: Im not at all trying to justify, I just want a way to be upfront and direct as a way to clearly state my position.

replies.author: Chacudno
replies.body: Short and direct. I like it

comments.author: rhinoceros100
comments.body: the haters are going to hate on you anyways, just say it like it is and don't worry about being politically correct

comments.author: fissionchips303
comments.body:
I would call out the actual tools used as a sort of special thanks, like:

AI Notice: This game was developed with the use of \_\_\_\_, \_\_\_\_, \_\_\_\_, \_\_\_\_ and \_\_\_\_\_. While we at <game company name> highly value artistic freedom and do not believe in using AI that would infringe on original creative works, we are also honored and grateful to the developers of these systems which have enabled us to create the game you are now playing. We have approached the use of AI with judiciousness, using it when appropriate and doing our best to balance our use of modern tools with a classic approach to craft. Without AI tools, this game would not have been built at all. We hope you enjoy our game.

replies.author: Bluetails_Buizel
replies.body:
\> Highly value artistic freedom 

Then antis are going to have a break down on this, they will say something like, tHaTs NoT HoW ArTiStiC FrEdMmon woRks!!! It’s StilL Stealing! And you are not even care about the environment at all!! XD

replies.author: Chacudno
replies.body: Really well said, that's a very nice blanket disclaimer. Gold star, I'll probably use that one.

comments.author: Chosen_Apex
comments.body:
I don't know how much AI you used, but the main character designs, story, and worldbuilding should at least be your own work, rignt?

I'd focus on the parts that actually make the game fun and give it its core experience. Then just tell people AI was only used to make some of the assets. What really matters is still the gameplay.

If the game is fun, I don't think anyone's going to care about this anyway.

replies.author: Chacudno
replies.body: I used AI for quick coding and 2D assets.

comments.author: CordusPorf
comments.body: You just have to wait until the next big game is made with ai, if it's Good's it's good, nobody will give a shit anymore.

comments.author: lovelessBertha
comments.body: The two letters from hell will launch them into a hysterical frenzy regardless. I wouldn't try too hard.

comments.author: yapdakilla81
comments.body:
AI, bridging the gap between imagination and reality...

also dont worry too much about it, anti AI folks are not your target market anyways.

comments.author: Motor-Master-4545
comments.body: Apple-like: "Made by AI, invented by Human"

replies.author: Chacudno
replies.body:
"But YOU didn't invent it!"

No but seriously thats a good zinger.

replies.author: Motor-Master-4545
replies.body: To refute that, I'd say that AI is based on human discovery and invention, and AI just remixes knowledge.

comments.author: blessed--
comments.body:
you dont have to appease these idiots who care, it ends up in a spiral, its what they want you to do, demean yourself because of what they think

you're making the game for yourself not anyone else, otherwise whats the point

comments.author: StoneCypher
comments.body: why are you bringing it up

replies.author: Chacudno
replies.body:
Why am I bringing up arguably the most heated topic in game development, on an AI game development sub reddit where discussions of AI use are the entire point of the sub, in an effort to ask about how to be forward about my use of it?

Idk man just feeling goofy I guess

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body:
no

i mean why are you spending your time trying to justify how you build software to the customers 

almost none of them care and the ones who do will never be satisfied 

just omit the topic entirely

replies.author: Chacudno
replies.body:
I dont know how i worded it that makes you and someone else think im justifying anything. There's nothing to justify, I just thought id say "Yo this has AI in it."

Like "These French fries are cooked in peanut oil"

comments.author: Am_Biyori
comments.body: I'll probably regret being the one to point this out, but 'Without AI I couldn't have done this' is one of a long list of things like- how old you are, how much time and effort it took you, how you had to do it all alone, all the sacrifices you had to make, etc- that players really don't care about and sounds a little unprofessional to mention at all.

replies.author: Chacudno
replies.body: So its better in your opinion to respond about AI use rather than be forward about it?

comments.author: cornelln
comments.body: No where in the post is why you want to do this. Many developers now use AI to code. I am not going to venture a guess. But I will guess it’s going to go up. When something is the default and will be more so the default over time why is disclosing it necessary at all?

comments.author: Lumpy_Conference6640
comments.body:
I just let it all hang out... I gen the fuck out of this unapologetically. 

If thier pro, they'll admire you, of you're anti they'll go the extra mile to vilify you. 

At least if you start out pro AF you'll filter out some of Anti Crazies.

comments.body:
